key.description: The merchant key is a unique identifier for a merchant account that is provided by PayU.

command.description: This parameter must have getBINInfo as command name.

var1.description: Specify any of the following values based on the output you require: 1, 2, or 3.

var2.description: Specify the BIN number or value based on the value specified in var1.

hash.description: This parameter must contain the hash value to be calculated at your end. Hash logic for this API is: sha512(key|command|var1|salt) sha512

var3.description: Specify the start index in this parameter. By default, the value will be set as 0.

var4.description: The offset is specified in this field. This is useful when several card bins are returned and you can display number of bins per page based on the offset. By default, it is set as 100.

var5.description: The parameter is used to check whether the Native OTP or SI is supported by the card.

var7.description: The parameter is used to check the SDK version and 3DS version supported by the provided BIN.
